description.en:
XMAN-R1 is KEENON's humanoid service robot for tasks requiring coordinated perception, manipulation and interaction with people. The company demonstrated it as a robotic barista at LEAP East 2026, carrying out a sequence that included handling a cup, operating the coffee-making workflow and delivering the finished drink after an order was placed on an iPad.

KEENON uses these demonstrations to illustrate multi-step task planning and controlled manipulation in commercial service settings. The examples establish the particular workflows shown; they do not by themselves establish unrestricted autonomous operation in an unfamiliar café or retail environment.
